mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications ( user_id, title, content, type, priority, is_read, expires_at, metadata, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{priority}, #{isRead}, #{expiresAt}, #{metadata, typeHandler=com.no99.edunexusnotification_and_communication.config.JsonTypeHandler}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET user_id = #{userId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, type = #{type}, priority = #{priority}, is_read = #{isRead}, read_at = #{readAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, metadata = #{metadata, typeHandler=com.no99.edunexusnotification_and_communication.config.JsonTypeHandler}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
